materials_exhausted.note: Bounded best-effort review reopened XML, PDF text, local OA images, nine DOC supplements via antiword, packet database JSONL, and merged APD6 sequence/experiment/literature rows. Remaining limitations are nonblocking cautions, not open rework targets.

adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed rework recovered primary activity rows for MsSN1 from Table 1, Results text, and figures; verified APD6 AP02436 against Figure 1/Table 1/Figure 8; replaced framework-only mechanism notes with conservative phenotype-level mechanism context; and closed the prior worker-2/4/6 rework ticket with cautions rather than clean acceptance.
summary: MsSN1 is publication-grade with cautions for AMP curation: the paper supports a 66-aa mature alfalfa snakin-1 sequence, exact bacterial inhibition-zone rows for rhizobial/Pseudomonas targets, qualitative Agrobacterium and Phoma inhibition, and plant-level antifungal/rhizosphere phenotypes. It does not support toxicity rows or a direct molecular mechanism.

caution_findings.evidence_context: packet_manifest remains material_extracted_with_gaps because supplement parsing was initially indexed-only, but all nine local DOC supplements were opened with antiword and no additional activity/toxicity tables were found.
Figure 3/6/7/8 provide visual phenotype evidence, but exact plotted values are not text-tabulated; qualitative rows are preserved and exact values are not invented.
APD6 AP02436 aggregate activity text is source-consistent but not structured per-assay evidence; Table 1/Figure 3/Figure 8 rows carry the primary-source activity evidence.
Local source supports antimicrobial phenotypes and ecological selectivity, not a direct molecular mechanism, hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or toxicity assay.
